bathAction.title: Wash wings
bathAction.tooltip: Wash along the wings, into the folds.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(open)] [npc.her] [npc.wings] as far as the room allows and [npc.verb(wash)] along them, into the folds and out to the edges. Dust and city grit rinse away. [npc.speech(Into the folds. They hold onto everything.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(stretch)] [npc.her] [npc.wings] into the steam and [npc.verb(wash)] them slowly, sighing when the hot water finds the joins. [npc.speech(Oh, the joins. Leave the water there.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] along [npc.her] [npc.wings] and [npc.verb(shake)] the water off them once they are clean. [npc.speech(They are done. Fold them.)]
